items.reason: Indonesia's first recorded protest at a rival's shelf claim north of Natuna (South Vietnam's 1971 concession decree), with the outermost-islands equidistance line insisted on; nothing comparable in 1971 (no candidates, no moves) or in the baseline, which has unilateral announcements but no protest. Known only from 1974 US cables quoting a Mining Ministry letter, so the coder may want it confirmed.

Statutory enactment of the shelf claim (Law 1/1973) is a new method against 1972, whose record shows only a negotiating-table protest (ev-9c94582a2a); declarative. Doubt: it is archipelago-wide and codifies the 1969 announcement in the baseline, so the coder may judge it maintenance rather than an SCS intensification.

Presidential ratification of Agip's contract area reaching into the disputed shelf could be a demonstrative novelty against 1972 (nothing comparable after ev-9c94582a2a), but the Agip contract dates from 1968 and was already ratified by Decree 68/1971, so it may only maintain an existing concession. Settle by finding Keppres 39/1973 and what it changed (the decree is known only from a 1974 Pertamina letter).

Drilling and a large gas discovery inside the shelf area South Vietnam claims is unilateral resource exploitation not shown in the 1973 record (law ev-934fda52f2 and contract-area decree ev-1005203f02 only); demonstrative. Doubt: secondary sources date Agip's D-Alpha discovery to 1973, so drilling may already have been under way in 1973, which would make this a continuation.

Air-force buildup on Natuna to deter South Vietnamese interference with drilling is the first military presence used for the claim in the record; nothing comparable in 1973 (ev-934fda52f2, ev-1005203f02) or the baseline; demonstrative.

Lead of the 1974 pressure on foreign oil companies: summoning Bow Valley, Shell and Santa Fe to quit South Vietnamese concessions, with a hint their Indonesian business would suffer, is a new method against 1973 (law and decree only, ev-934fda52f2, ev-1005203f02); coercive as the highest type of the group.

Pertamina's 30 April/12 June letter advising all contractors not to take South Vietnamese concessions is the opening step of the same pressure campaign as ev-902f2ee3f3 (same companies' question, same weeks); one move.

An internal presidential decision not to go beyond the June 1972 compromise is a decision, not observable behaviour (the series dates behaviour), and it holds rather than hardens the position shown in ev-9c94582a2a; likely reject or context. Settle by whether the decision was conveyed to South Vietnam in 1974.

An internal Mining Ministry note asking Hankam to protect Agip and to hold the 'Agip line' is a decision document, not public; if the coder counts it, it belongs as evidence with the military-protection move ev-b3b40540a4 rather than as a move of its own. Settle by whether any protective deployment followed beyond the Natuna buildup.

Licensing a further exploratory well in the disputed shelf continues the 1974 practice of drilling there (ev-ad1b102653) at the same level, without the military escort that would mark an escalation; continuation, provisional until 1974 is decided.

Refusing Vietnam's demanded moratorium and threatening to scrap the communiqué rather than stop exploration is a diplomatic assertion with nothing comparable in 1976 (no candidates), so it is new again; declarative. Doubt: a May 1978 Vientiane cable says the two sides agreed not to exploit unresolved areas, so the coder may want the outcome settled first.

The 1977 record (ev-0245dbdd94) shows Indonesian oil exploration already under way in the disputed shelf and defended against a moratorium; Marathon's 1978 find continues that exploration at the same level. Doubt: it is in a different contract area (northwest of Natuna), so a coder who reads it as new acreage could call it scope.

Rejecting Vietnam's thalweg line in the 1978 talks repeats the 1977 refusal of Vietnam's positions in bilateral diplomacy (ev-0245dbdd94) at the same level, inside a cooperative negotiation; continuation, likely reject.

Lead of the 1979 Natuna bloc round: tendering ten new blocs, three partly in the area disputed with Vietnam, is a new method against 1978, whose record shows exploration only in an existing contract (ev-fe81521c5a) and talks (ev-28e2c68f85); demonstrative.
The Gulf contract for Bloc A is one of the awards of the bloc round led by ev-bbef893415; one move.
The Marathon contract for Bloc B, signed despite Vietnam's protest, is an award of the bloc round led by ev-bbef893415; one move.
The Mobil and Amoseas contracts (Bloc C partly disputed) and Subroto's pledge to continue are the last awards of the bloc round led by ev-bbef893415; one move.

Mochtar's statement to parliament dismissing Vietnam's protest at the awards is the declarative side of the bloc round led by ev-bbef893415; alternatively a continuation of the 1978 rejection of Vietnam's positions (ev-28e2c68f85).
